calibration: Difficulty values are explicit starting parameters, not measured skill ratings. Native turn, roster, position and terrain observations remain exact at every tier. This file selects skills; accounts are provisioned separately.
behaviorContract: Armor S1 is used for current combat and excavation. Automatic S2 is disabled: the user deferred build-specific runtime calibration. Its eventual policy remains DIRECT shots with at least 80% model robustness and a validated native continuation/per-impact safety model; never excavation or SS. Model percentages are nine bounded angle/power stress-test results, NOT calibrated real-world hit probabilities: +/-1 native degree censored at native limits, +/-max(4, observed charge error + 2) power units. Aim at the native body-envelope center; terrain collision takes priority over body intersection, neither is guaranteed damage. Compare living enemies and supported 12/24/36/48px positions in one 1600ms tactical budget; movement energy is not assumed to equal pixels. Two-hop supported goals and at most four observed-shot memories last only within the match. Sample input-side angle/power and target-estimation noise once per native turn; reduce it to 20% before integer quantization for an observed, scene-matching, re-simulated shot. Never perturb authoritative ownership, turn, life, positions, wind or movement safety data. Delays are milliseconds.
shot2CalibrationContract: The user chose runtime calibration later. This build hard-disables automatic S2; JSON cannot enable it. status accepts deferred (current) or pending, the eventual minimumModelConfidencePercent stays 80, nativeSelectionVerified stays false, and every reserved model/evidence/selection/projectile/envelope field stays null. A claimed verified status or supplied parameters are rejected, not treated as calibration. Exact-client static findings identify S2 as ODoubleBullet with first/second-impact state at +0x344 and collision reset/continuation after its first impact, unlike S1's OBullet. Native launch muzzle fields differ: S1 uses decoded +0x1C0/+0x1C8, S2 +0x1D0/+0x1D8; both launch paths pass decoded +0x1A8 angle and +0x254 power. S2 native legal angle limits must be reacquired after weapon selection. These findings rule out the old independent single-impact Euler envelope for this build; they do NOT establish runtime trajectory, safe blast radii, damage, or complete continuation semantics. Future activation requires an explicitly bounded, implemented and build/runtime-validated continuation/per-impact safety model with the actual S2 launch telemetry. Never substitute S1 muzzle/blast physics, infer a split model, or add an SS-style airtime threshold. Eventual S2 policy remains >=80% MODEL-estimate DIRECT shots only with safety checked for all impacts; S1 remains the digging weapon. Parent tracks deferred calibration separately.

nativeEquipment.encoding: Item = typeBits | localId. Body=0x08000, head=0x18000, glasses=0x28000 for male items; shared flags=0x38000. localId occupies bits 0..14. Female body/head/glasses have bit 15 clear. Type 0x30000 is a bundle, not a female flag.
nativeEquipment.ownership: Chest.Owner is the individual bot identity (BotOne, BotTwo or BotThree), Wearing=1, Acquisition='T', Expire=NULL, Volume=1, PlaceOrder=0, Recovered=0, ExpireType='I'. Chest.No is an auto-generated inventory serial, never an item ID.
nativeEquipment.legacyGameFields: Preserve AvatarWear, Prop1 and Prop2 byte-for-byte. The supplied Serv3 equipment/login SQL does not use them; no Serv2 packed-hex encoding is assumed.
nativeEquipment.statsAffectPlay: These are not stat-free cosmetics. Combat effects depend on the native Avatar-on/game options; reward effects and effective match strength have not been calibrated.
nativeEquipment.statUnits: Raw sums from the shipped native avatar catalog, not percentages or measured difficulty. Native Golden Helmet delay is -3; the later MenuDat row instead says +3.
